It's hard to believe, but it's already been 6 years since we started our journey! We're grateful for all of your support and loyalty, and to show our appreciation, we're offering a special Anniversary Sale here on Steam!

6 years, 16 games to discover, including Alaloth - Champions of The Four Kingdoms and many other, including small gems like The 7th Circle - Endless Nightmare or The Wardrobe - Even Better Edition!

Get 60% off on all of our games starting today. Celebrate this milestone with us and take advantage of this limited-time offer. Thanks for being a part of our family. Here's to many more years of gaming together! 

#SteamAnniversary #CustomerLove #6YearsStrong

notes.title: UNIT 4 CELEBRATES ITS FIRST BIRTHDAY AND GOES 90% OFF!
notes.content:
Hello world, it's time to celebrate the first birthday of our baby boy here at Gamera Interactive! A year is passed, a lot of things happened and we are working hard on new amazing projects right now, without forgetting that everything started with these guys here, saving the universe.

We won many different awards with the game, including Videogamer GOTY at the end of 2017 and we hope who have missed the chance to play it, will finally jump in with this amazing weekly deal ending on May, 28!

Come on, join The Unit!

notes.title: CLASH OF AGENTS AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.content:
Gamera Interactive announces Clash of Agents add-on content for its old school action-platform Unit 4. The DLC is available now on Steam and includes three new competitive minigames for amazing challenges with your friends!

● The frantic coin arena of Nestiwal, full of super-bouncing plants that make this planet scene of the most hardened competitions: collect the higher number of coins and humiliate your opponents. Reservations required

● The deadly fights of Noxios IV, the planet known as "The Cage" among the most experienced travellers of the galaxy. Are you brave enough for the challenge? We hope you are not afraid of closed spaces!

● The dizziness-inducing climb of Tamukame, the planet that offers an incredibly towering itinerary to all the galaxy explorers who love hardcore climbing. But be wary, boxes are heavy!

The DLC comes with improved gameplay, minor fixes and a lot of extra fun! Hope you enjoy!

notes.title: 28 DAYS LATER
notes.content:
Hello world and welcome on Unit 4 here on Steam. The game is avalaible since a while but it's time to give you all the proper welcome we didn't have the chance to work on one month ago. Unit 4 is born as a console exclusive but plans can change sometime and that's what happened to us and to our first game just a few days before the launch. 

Of course it has been great for us but we've been pushed in a loop of hard work & crazy busy days with E3 in the middle and GamesCom on the way, so we've been able to pop-up here and say hello right now! During this first month we heard your feeds and we worked on many different updates to polish the game and fix bugs. We had two different updates after launch (the first one at the end of May, the second one during the first week of June) but it's time to make the point on how things are going and on what is going to happen in the near future. 

First of all, you can find a list of fixes made yesterday, including the old stuff already changed with the previous CU:
[list]
[*]Jump has been made more fluid, if you jump once, you can jump again as you touch the floor (we deleted the jump delay originally implemented) [*]Bees colliders fixed
[*]Rose drones colliders fixed
[*]Resolution problems fixed (16:9 proportion is maintained even if 1920x1080 res is not available)
 [*]Garriott Starship is now in the Encyclopedia Galactica
 [*]Achievement "Look at my garage!" text is now correct (now the showed number of pieces you must buy from Pablo  is 48, instead of 20 that was the wrong number, previously visible in the description of the achievement)
 [*]SFXs volumes have been fixed
 [*]Yellow Fashion Sprite fixed (during movement Yellow’s hat disappeared, now it stays visible)
 [*]Security systems and laser levels have been fixed (some of the traps sometime didn’t work as intended)
[/list]
So what's going next? We are still working on various fixes and optimization even because Unity update we had to do, broke things here and there as usual. The largest part is already fixed but we are now investigating on how this affected the first DLC of the game, we are going to announce in the next weeks. Stay tuned and thank you for your support!
